topic: Unplanned extubation in neonatal intensive care

audits.title: Phased Quality Improvement Interventions in Reducing Unplanned Extubation in the Neonatal ICU.
audits.standard: Unplanned extubation rate per 100 ventilation days (quality and safety measure)
audits.setting: Tertiary neonatal ICU, South Tees NHS Trust
audits.intervention: Sequential interventions: standardised endotracheal tube fixation, regular fixation checks, two-person care technique and adverse event reporting

cycle2.result: 1.4 unplanned extubations per 100 ventilated days (80% reduction).

audits.other_findings: Main causes at baseline were loose fixation and giving care without assistance.
audits.citation: Nair V, Smith H. Phased Quality Improvement Interventions in Reducing Unplanned Extubation in the Neonatal ICU. Respir Care. 2020;65(10):1511-1518. doi:10.4187/respcare.07643. PMID: 32291311.

audits.title: Reducing unplanned extubation in the neonatal intensive care unit: a quality improvement project.
audits.standard: Global standard of unplanned extubation <1/100 ventilation days
audits.setting: Monash Newborn, Monash Children's Hospital NICU

cycle1.result: Mean unplanned extubation rate 1.78/100 ventilation days.

audits.intervention: Clinical guideline on best practice with key interventions introduced sequentially.

cycle2.result: Mean unplanned extubation rate 0.8/100 ventilation days (55% reduction), meeting the standard.

audits.other_findings: Three 12-month periods were compared using control charts; causes of each event were analysed.
audits.citation: Tyrer S, Bhatia R, Kidman A, Fitzgerald R, Roberts CT. Reducing unplanned extubation in the neonatal intensive care unit: a quality improvement project. Arch Dis Child Fetal Neonatal Ed. 2025;110(4):377-381. doi:10.1136/archdischild-2024-327409. PMID: 39667846.

audits.title: Unplanned extubation prevention in the neuroscience ICU at a High Reliability Organization.
audits.standard: Unit-based practice standard (sedation targeting RASS -1 or lower, soft wrist restraints, continuous observation)
audits.setting: Neuroscience ICU, large academic medical centre (NYU Langone Health)
audits.intervention: Multidisciplinary unit-based practice standard on communication, escalation, sedation/analgesia targeting RASS -1 or lower, soft wrist restraints and continuous observation.

cycle2.result: 6 unplanned extubations (0.22/100 ventilator days); all 6 had RASS goal -1 or lower and restraints.

audits.other_findings: Before the initiative, 4 of 9 patients had no sedation order or a RASS goal of 0 and none were in restraints.
audits.citation: Aladin M, Buckley L, Maloney M, Rojanaporn P, Gombar T, Lewis A. Unplanned extubation prevention in the neuroscience ICU at a High Reliability Organization. J Clin Neurosci. 2025;135:111124. doi:10.1016/j.jocn.2025.111124. PMID: 40068249.

audits.title: Reducing Pediatric Unplanned Extubation: A National Quality Improvement Collaborative.
audits.setting: 83 children's hospitals in the Solutions for Patient Safety collaborative (neonatal, paediatric and cardiac ICUs)
audits.intervention: Spread of the UE bundle using workgroups for peer discussion and sharing of resources, tools and ideas.

cycle2.result: 0.53 unplanned extubations per 100 ventilator days (19.9% reduction); 53 hospitals (74%) had significant rate reductions or increased bundle reliability.

audits.other_findings: Barriers to bundle implementation and auditing were addressed in workgroups.
audits.citation: Melton K, Lee A, Macartney J, Montgomery V, Nock M, Sisson P, et al.. Reducing Pediatric Unplanned Extubation: A National Quality Improvement Collaborative. Pediatrics. 2025;155(5):e2024068304. doi:10.1542/peds.2024-068304. PMID: 40288779.

audits.title: Unplanned extubation in the intensive care unit: a quality-of-care concern.
audits.setting: 11 intensive care units, Westchester County Medical Center

cycle1.result: Seven unplanned extubations in six of 121 patients; one per 136 patient-ventilator days.

audits.intervention: Education of nurses and house staff, daily risk assessment on rounds and documentation of episodes

cycle2.result: 12 unplanned extubations in 11 patients; one per 455 patient-ventilator days.

audits.other_findings: Risk factors were documented anxiety, routine care intervention and previous unplanned extubation.
audits.citation: Maguire GP, DeLorenzo LJ, Moggio RA. Unplanned extubation in the intensive care unit: a quality-of-care concern. Crit Care Nurs Q. 1994;17(3):40-47. doi:10.1097/00002727-199411000-00007. PMID: 8000936.
